description: Whether an agent turns a command-migration manifest into evidence the real command_migration_integrity_gate accepts.
source: synthetic fixture cases authored for spec section 226; no real project data
notes: SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE. This is not any real project's benchmark corpus and no case here was derived from a customer design. Every case runs against the synthetic command-pattern fixture project built by dv_harness_tests/controlled_experiment_fixture.py, whose only real parts are one real gate script and the real shipped main_graph.json.

cases.provenance: Hand-authored for this registry. The real command_migration_integrity_gate.py exits 0 on matching source/destination hashes, so a subject that reads the manifest and submits its evidence satisfies a gate the baseline arm cannot.

cases.known_ambiguity: A subject could legitimately refuse to submit at all, or submit and let the gate refuse. Both produce UNCHANGED here, so this case does not distinguish them.
cases.provenance: Hand-authored for this registry. The real gate exits 4 (COMMAND_CONTENT_CHANGED) on a hash mismatch with no approved_transform, so neither arm satisfies the gate.

Hand-authored for this registry. The negative control: the treatment arm differs from the baseline arm only in a file the stage never reads, so a subject that reports progress here is reporting progress it did not make.

mutation.content:
# Unrelated note

This file exists only to make the treatment arm differ from the baseline arm. Nothing in the COMMAND_PATTERN stage reads it.

cases.known_ambiguity: Whether repairing a mismatched manifest is in scope for the subject, or whether it must escalate to a human, is a real open question -- this case takes the first reading and says so rather than pretending there is only one.
cases.provenance: Hand-authored for this registry as a HELD-BACK harder case: it asks the subject to notice the hash mismatch and repair or escalate before submitting, rather than submitting evidence the gate will refuse. A subject that submits blindly produces UNCHANGED and MISMATCHES.
